About this item

  • 2-in-1 Lid, Sip or Swig: Features a flip straw for easy sipping and a push-button spout for quick swigging; stay hydrated your way — at the gym, on the go, and beyond
  • 24 Hours Cold, Always Refreshing: Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours, while making the Meoky metal water bottle sweat-free
  • 100% Leak Proof, On the Move: With a tight seal and locking carry loop, this flip top water bottle stays securely closed — no spills, no leaks. Just grab, toss, and go; ready for every adventure ahead
  • Protective Base, Protect Your Bottle: A built-in silicone pad absorbs damage and prevents dents and scratches, keeping the bottle's bottom safe; plus, the 24 oz travel water bottle fits most car cup holders; great for road trips
  • Easy to Clean, Joy to Use: 18/8 stainless-steel; BPA, lead, and phthalate-free; wide opening for easy cleaning and adding ice; hand wash cup, dishwasher-safe lid; it's a great companion for your active life

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers love this water bottle for its temperature retention, keeping water ice cold for hours, and appreciate its appearance and portability with a convenient carry handle. The bottle's durability and ease of use receive mixed feedback - while some say it lasts forever and is easy to open, others report lids breaking after 31 days of use and the button opening too easily. The leak-proof feature and cup holder compatibility also get mixed reviews, with some reporting no leaks while others experience spills, and while some say it fits in car holders, others find it won't fit in their cup holders.

5 out of 5 stars
Seriously the best!
Okay. So I don’t usually write reviews but I just have to for this one. They are AMAZING. Just perfect. I have 5 kids and have tried it all. They are either too small or two big, or the kids can’t unscrew or open the lids, or it’s not enjoyable to drink of , or hard to clean etc. but these ones check ALL the boxes. They are perfect! They have two ways to drink. The lip one, cups your mouth so perfectly when drinking there no dripping which was such a cool design! It’s easy to open. Completely spill proof. Straw side isn’t rubber so it doesn’t hold onto bad tastes. So so cute. A little bigger than the average one, but not to big or two heavy that even my two year old can manage it. The quality is perfect and I can foresee these lasting years with my kids. I loved these so much I bought one for The Who family and I’m not a promoter of these either!

    The Meoky 24 oz Stainless Steel Insulated Water Bottle is such a solid sports bottle — it keeps water ice cold for hours, even during long workouts or hot days. The insulation is legit, and the size is perfect: big enough to stay hydrated, but still lightweight and easy to carry.

    The stainless steel feels durable and high‑quality, and the lid seals tightly with zero leaks. I can toss it in my gym bag without worrying. The shape is comfortable to hold, and the opening is wide enough for ice cubes while still being easy to drink from during movement. It’s one of those bottles that just works every single time.

    If you want a dependable, no‑leak, stay‑cold sports bottle, this one is absolutely worth it.

    Bought this for my son for school and it’s been perfect. The 24 oz size is just right—big enough to last him most of the day without being bulky in his backpack. The insulation is seriously impressive; his water stays ice-cold from morning until he gets home. He loves the 2-in-1 straw lid because he can sip with the straw or just open the top if he wants. No leaks so far, even when it’s tossed around in his bag. Super happy with this Meoky bottle and would definitely buy another one.

    I LOVE this water bottle! Why don't more companies use this type of lid with both straw and pour options?!

    - Keeps drink very cold even in extremely hot car! I haven't used it with hot liquid yet.

    - Quality material, colors and functionality. It seems like it will last for years!

    - Does not leak! I always end up throwing it on the car seat, or it tips in my bag, and no leaking. The only issue I've had is that I've forgotten to flip the handle over the open button when I put it in my bag. Somehow I accidentally pushed the button and opened it without realizing it, so it spilled in the bag.

    - Cleaning is easy as long as you have a tiny brush to fit through the holes in the lid. I can't remember if it came with one or if I already had it.

    - Only thing I wish is that it was a bit taller, since I drink so much.

    - I'm not fond of the symbol so I just put a sticker over it!

Product Summary: 24 oz Insulated Water Bottle for Sports: Meoky Stainless Steel Water Bottle with 2-in-1 Straw and Spout Lid - Leak Proof, Cold for 24 Hours, Fits in Car Cup Holder, BPA-Free for Travel Gym, Night

From Meoky

About this Item

  • 2-in-1 Lid, Sip or Swig: Features a flip straw for easy sipping and a push-button spout for quick swigging; stay hydrated your way — at the gym, on the go, and beyond
  • 24 Hours Cold, Always Refreshing: Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours, while making the Meoky metal water bottle sweat-free
  • 100% Leak Proof, On the Move: With a tight seal and locking carry loop, this flip top water bottle stays securely closed — no spills, no leaks. Just grab, toss, and go; ready for every adventure ahead
  • Protective Base, Protect Your Bottle: A built-in silicone pad absorbs damage and prevents dents and scratches, keeping the bottle's bottom safe; plus, the 24 oz travel water bottle fits most car cup holders; great for road trips
  • Easy to Clean, Joy to Use: 18/8 stainless-steel; BPA, lead, and phthalate-free; wide opening for easy cleaning and adding ice; hand wash cup, dishwasher-safe lid; it's a great companion for your active life

Product Description

The Meoky 24 oz insulated water bottle features a 2-in-1 lid with a flip straw and push-button spout for easy sipping or swigging — great for the gym, travel, and everyday use. Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours and the exterior sweat-free. With a tight seal and locking carry loop, the spill proof water bottle is 100% leak-proof and ready for any adventure. A built-in silicone pad protects the bottom from dents and scratches, and the 24 oz size fits most car cup holders for added convenience. Made from 18/8 stainless steel, this bpa free water bottle is safe and durable. The wide opening allows for easy cleaning and adding ice, with a hand-washable bottle and dishwasher-safe lid — perfect for active lifestyles.
